# Security, Integration and Operations Checklist: Central Authentication and Authorization Service

**Purpose**: Validate that the specification, plan and contracts define security, consumer-integration and operational requirements completely, clearly and consistently before task generation
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md), [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Depth / audience**: formal pre-implementation gate for the author and a PR reviewer. Items evaluate what is written, not whether code works. Certificate items apply because the clarification permits (but does not require) X.509; the plan supports both PEM and PFX sources.

## Authentication Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Is the email login identifier defined precisely (format validation, case-insensitivity, normalization, maximum length)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "indistinguishable" failure defined with a measurable standard for body, status and timing, rather than "as far as practical"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005, SC-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the non-credential failure paths (malformed email, missing fields, rate-limit 429, lockout) specified so that none reveals account existence? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contracts §login]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the externally visible behavior of lockout defined consistently between the spec's "throttle" and the plan's 5-failure/15-minute lockout? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, Plan §R5]
- [ ] CHK005 Are throttle thresholds (attempts, window, scope per account vs per source) quantified in a requirement rather than left to implementation? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK006 Is disabled-user behavior specified for every entry point: login, refresh, reset-code redemption, and tokens already issued? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the acceptable lag between disabling a user and consumer APIs rejecting that user's existing access token stated as a measurable bound (the token lifetime)? [Measurability, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Does the spec list everything that must never expose passwords (responses, logs, errors, token claims, documentation examples) rather than only responses and logs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements for other secrets that must stay out of logs (access tokens, refresh tokens, reset codes, key material, bootstrap password) stated in the spec, not only in the constitution and plan? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, FR-015]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the password rule stated in one authoritative place and applied consistently to creation, reset and bootstrap? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the requirement for transport security (HTTPS/TLS termination) for credentials and tokens in transit defined, or explicitly assigned to the deployment environment? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the trust level of an Administrator in the reset workflow stated, given that a reset code lets the issuing Administrator set the user's password and sign in as them? [Gap, Assumption, Spec §FR-014]

## Authorization Requirements

- [ ] CHK013 Is the role set stated identically (names, spelling, case) in the spec, constitution, plan and contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Plan §Data Model]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the behavior of role-name matching defined (case-sensitive, exact) for the role route value and role arrays in requests? [Clarity, Contracts §user administration]
- [ ] CHK015 Is each Administrator-only operation enumerated so no administration endpoint is ambiguous (including password reset issuance)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Contracts §User administration]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the status code distinction between unauthenticated (401) and unauthorized (403) specified for administration endpoints in the spec, not only in the contract? [Gap, Spec §FR-012, Contracts]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the rules protecting the system from lockout (last enabled Administrator, last remaining role) complete for every operation that can change those states, including self-modification? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the requirement that role information from clients is never trusted stated with concrete cases (create user request, role assignment, token claims presented to the service)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the consumer API authorization expectations specified (what a consumer must check, how roles map to claims, how multiple roles are treated, what Manager/Operator may do in consumers)? [Completeness, Spec §Authorization, FR-030]
- [ ] CHK020 Does the spec define the rejection outcome for unsupported roles in every place a role can enter (assignment, user creation, route value)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, Contracts]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the intended relationship between Manager and Operator privileges defined, or explicitly left to each consumer API? [Ambiguity, Spec §Roles]

## Token and Key Requirements

- [ ] CHK022 Is the token authority boundary stated: what this service signs, what consumers must verify, and that consumers never call this service per request? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §Consumer API Independence]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the issuer value defined as a configurable requirement with rules for consumers to match it exactly? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, Contracts §token]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the audience model defined (one shared audience versus one per consumer API), including how a new consumer API is added without reissuing tokens? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, FR-030]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the access-token lifetime stated as a requirement with allowed configuration range and the permitted clock skew for consumers? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007, Contracts §token]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the minimum claim set consistent across the spec, research and contract (sub, role, iss, aud, exp, plus iat/nbf/jti), and is the exclusion of email stated as a requirement? [Consistency, Spec §Authorization, Plan §R3]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the claim shape for roles unambiguous when a user holds one role versus several? [Clarity, Contracts §token]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the asymmetric algorithm and minimum key strength stated as a requirement, including rejection of weaker keys at startup? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Plan §R1, §R11]
- [ ] CHK029 Are private and public signing material separated in requirements for every artifact (image, repository, logs, JWKS, documentation, consumer configuration)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, Constitution §V]
- [ ] CHK030 Are consumer requirements for validating tokens stated so that no database access, password data or service call is needed, including the failure behavior when the key source is unreachable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the requirement that refresh tokens must never be accepted by consumer APIs stated? [Gap, Contracts §Refresh token]

## Certificate and Key Management Requirements (X.509 permitted)

- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements for handling the private certificate or key defined end to end (provisioning, storage permissions, who can read it, password handling)? [Completeness, Plan §R1, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK033 Is public certificate/key distribution specified, including whether consumers must use the JWKS endpoint, a static file, or either, and who updates them on rotation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Contracts §JWKS]
- [ ] CHK034 Are certificate/key expiration requirements defined (behavior when the signing certificate is expired or near expiry, and whether the service fails, warns or continues)? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the rotation procedure defined with measurable overlap rules (minimum overlap equals token lifetime plus skew) and a defined effect on in-flight tokens? [Measurability, Spec §Edge Cases, Contracts §Rotation]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the key identifier strategy defined as a requirement (what `kid` is derived from, who consumes it, behavior of a consumer that sees an unknown `kid`)? [Gap, Plan §R1, Contracts §token]
- [ ] CHK037 Is emergency key replacement (suspected compromise) specified, including whether tokens signed by the old key are rejected immediately? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the publication scope of the JWKS endpoint (anonymous, cacheable, public-only parameters) required rather than only described in the contract? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]

## Session Renewal Requirements

- [ ] CHK039 Are the refresh-token lifetime and whether it is absolute or sliding stated unambiguously? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the persistence requirement for refresh tokens stated precisely (non-recoverable form, uniqueness, minimum entropy) in the spec and not only in the plan? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Plan §R4]
- [ ] CHK041 Is the retention and cleanup of expired, rotated and revoked token records specified, given that reuse detection depends on keeping them? [Gap, Plan §R4]
- [ ] CHK042 Is behavior for two concurrent renewals with the same token defined, including the user-visible outcome? [Edge Case, Plan §R4]
- [ ] CHK043 Is the definition of "session" (token family) and the scope of revocation consistent across logout, reuse detection, disable and reset? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, FR-018, FR-014]
- [ ] CHK044 Is reuse-detection behavior fully specified, including which tokens become invalid and what the legitimate user must do next? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK045 Are logout semantics defined for edge inputs (unknown, expired or already revoked token, missing body) and for idempotency? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018, Contracts §logout]
- [ ] CHK046 Does the spec state whether an administrator disabling or resetting a user must immediately stop renewal, as distinct from existing access tokens? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, FR-018]

## Initial Administrator Requirements

- [ ] CHK047 Are the exact bootstrap preconditions defined (zero users, configuration present) including the case where the store is empty but configuration is missing in Development versus Production? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, User Story 6]
- [ ] CHK048 Is the mechanism for becoming unavailable defined and objectively verifiable by an operator (observable signal after the first user exists)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-019, Plan §R7]
- [ ] CHK049 Is atomicity of bootstrap specified (creating the user and assigning the Administrator role succeed or fail together, and a failed run is safely retried)? [Gap, Plan §R7]
- [ ] CHK050 Is the handling of the bootstrap secret defined (how supplied, when to remove, not logged, not stored)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Plan §R7]
- [ ] CHK051 Is behavior defined for the corner case where all users have been removed from a previously initialized store, and is it intended to reopen bootstrap? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-019]

## Persistence and Data Preservation Requirements

- [ ] CHK052 Is durability of the SQLite data across container replacement stated as a testable requirement, including which paths must live on persistent storage (database and data-protection keys)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-025, Plan §R6, §R8]
- [ ] CHK053 Is the dependency of password-reset validity on persisted data-protection keys captured in a requirement and in backup scope? [Gap, Plan §R6]
- [ ] CHK054 Are requirements for applying migrations defined for clean install, upgrade, and failure (partial migration, rollback or restore path)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-025, Plan §R8]
- [ ] CHK055 Is a policy defined for destructive or irreversible migrations and for downgrades? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK056 Is "production startup never deletes or resets data" expressed as an observable requirement covering migration, bootstrap and test code paths? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, Constitution §VI]
- [ ] CHK057 Are concurrency and single-writer expectations for SQLite stated (single instance only, behavior if two instances share the volume)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Containerized Development Requirements

- [ ] CHK058 Is the prohibition on installing .NET or project tooling in the agent container stated as a requirement with an unambiguous scope (SDK, EF tools, SQLite tools)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028, Constitution §IX]
- [ ] CHK059 Are the requirements for creating and using the dev environment through the host Docker daemon defined, including how repository files reach containers when the agent itself runs in a container? [Gap, Spec §FR-028, Plan §R12]
- [ ] CHK060 Is it specified how bind-mounted paths resolve when Compose is invoked from a container against the host daemon, since volume sources are interpreted by the host? [Gap, Risk, Plan §R12]
- [ ] CHK061 Are restore, build, test, migration creation and migration application each covered by a documented Docker-based command requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028, Quickstart]
- [ ] CHK062 Is the complete list of host prerequisites (Docker version, Compose v2, permissions, network access for package restore, writable cache volumes) stated so none is undocumented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027, FR-028]
- [ ] CHK063 Is the container health-check approach defined given the runtime image may not contain an HTTP client? [Ambiguity, Plan §R12]

## Production Documentation Requirements

- [ ] CHK064 Is "readable but not interactive" defined with an objective acceptance criterion (what must be absent: send button, server URL, credential input, proxy)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-024, SC-008]
- [ ] CHK065 Is the verification method for read-only production behavior specified, given the plan could not confirm the Scalar option and lists three fallbacks? [Ambiguity, Plan §R9]
- [ ] CHK066 Is the exposure decision for production documentation stated (anonymous access to the API surface description is accepted, or access is restricted)? [Assumption, Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK067 Is the content that must never appear in production documentation listed (example tokens, internal URLs, configuration values, key material)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024]

## Operations and Integration Requirements

- [ ] CHK068 Are the configuration items listed as requirements with required/optional status, defaults and failure behavior, and are production-fatal misconfigurations enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026, FR-027, Plan §R11]
- [ ] CHK069 Are backup and restore requirements specific on consistency (service stopped versus online), scope (database, key ring, signing key custody) and a recovery success measure? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027, SC-012]
- [ ] CHK070 Is the set of "common authentication failures" for troubleshooting enumerated, so documentation completeness can be judged? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK071 Are consumer integration requirements complete for configuration inputs, required validation parameters, role policies for Administrator, Manager and Operator, and rotation handling? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030, SC-011]
- [ ] CHK072 Is a security-relevant event logging requirement defined (what is recorded for failed sign-ins, reuse detection, role changes, bootstrap) without recording secrets? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK073 Are CORS requirements (allowed frontend origins, production defaults) captured in the spec, since the shared frontend is a stated client? [Gap, Plan §R10]
- [ ] CHK074 Are health-check requirements specific about what the endpoint may and may not reveal? [Clarity, Plan §R10, Contracts §Health]
- [ ] CHK075 Are availability and recovery expectations (recovery time, acceptable downtime during key rotation or migration) stated or explicitly excluded? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Testing Scope Requirements

- [ ] CHK076 Does the spec require coverage of every item in the minimum validation gate, and is each mapped to a verifiable behavior? [Traceability, Spec §FR-029, SC-010, Constitution §XI]
- [ ] CHK077 Is the absence of an exhaustive-test and coverage-percentage requirement stated consistently in the spec, plan and constitution? [Consistency, Spec §Testing Expectation, Plan §R13]
- [ ] CHK078 Is the priority order of tested risk areas (authentication, authorization, token/session, real persistence) consistent between spec and plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-029, Plan §R13]
- [ ] CHK079 Is "real persistence integration" defined as using the actual SQLite provider and Identity, and are mocks of those components excluded by requirement? [Clarity, Plan §R13, Constitution §XI]
- [ ] CHK080 Is the scope of architecture boundary checks defined by requirement (which references are forbidden) so the check list is neither open-ended nor omitted? [Clarity, Plan §Constitution Check, Constitution §I]

## Cross-Cutting Consistency

- [ ] CHK081 Do the endpoints added in the plan (password-reset issue and redeem, JWKS) trace to explicit spec requirements and acceptance scenarios? [Traceability, Spec §FR-010, FR-014, Plan §Key Design Decisions]
- [ ] CHK082 Is there an ID scheme linking each success criterion to its functional requirements so unmapped requirements can be detected? [Traceability, Gap]
- [ ] CHK083 Are all values presented as defaults (15 min, 7 days, 24 h, lockout counts) marked as configurable with validation bounds in one authoritative place? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, FR-014, FR-016]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- Likeliest real defects found while drafting, worth resolving before `/speckit-tasks`: CHK011 (TLS), CHK012 (admin reset trust), CHK034 (certificate expiry behavior), CHK049 (bootstrap atomicity), CHK060 (host-path bind mounts when the agent runs in a container), CHK065 (Scalar production mode unverified), CHK072 (security event logging)
